title: Blockheads signed mod index (index.json)
description: Built by the Blockheads-Club/mods CI from every entry file and signed with the index ed25519 key. The signature is a detached minisign file `index.json.minisig` next to `index.json`, made over the exact bytes of `index.json`; consumers (game, Patcher, website, server) ship the public key and must verify it before reading the file. Entries are sorted by id, versions in publication order.

api.description: blockheads:api versions the index CI checked against.
